title: Eastbank Apartments | Winter comfort pilot
titleZh: 東岸公寓｜冬季舒適度改善試行
passage:
We are trying two removable measures this winter. A draft strip may be fitted only to a window that remains fully shut while the room is in use; it does not block ordinary drafts elsewhere in the room. A thermal curtain can be opened at any time, but its lower edge must stop above a wall heater. We have a short version for that purpose. Thick curtains do little for people who have to keep a room well lit during the day, because they work only when closed.

The sewing room is occupied in the afternoon. Staff open the window during every work session, but they are willing to use ceiling lights and close a curtain. The heater sits where the lower part of a standard curtain would hang. The music room is used at night; its window stays closed, and air comes in around the loose window frame. The teacher needs to see the courtyard from that room while teaching. These rooms have separate budgets, so a measure available for one is not taken away from the other.

A resident may ask for an adjustment and still stay in the pilot. Staff can book a short service call for a pull that needs to move only along the existing rail. If the rail has to move, or the curtain’s length has to change, staff must arrange to measure the room again before booking the work. A resident’s photo helps staff choose which appointment to offer, but it does not replace a measurement. If a request mentions two possible fixes, decide which of them would work rather than automatically booking the longer visit.
passageZh:
今年冬天，我們要試行兩種可拆除的改善措施。防風條只能裝在房間有人使用時會全程關緊的窗戶上；它不能阻擋從房間其他地方吹進來的一般氣流。隔熱窗簾可隨時拉開，但下緣必須停在壁掛式暖氣上方。我們有短版窗簾可供使用。需要在白天維持室內明亮的人，使用厚窗簾效益不大，因為窗簾必須拉上才有效。

縫紉室在下午有人使用。工作人員每次工作時都會開窗，但願意開天花板的燈並拉上窗簾。暖氣的位置會被標準長度窗簾的下部遮住。音樂教室晚上使用，窗戶保持關閉，但空氣會從鬆動的窗框滲入。老師上課時需要看得到庭院。兩間房的預算各自獨立，不會因某項措施用在其中一間，另一間就不能使用。

住戶可以請團隊調整設備，並繼續參與試行。如果拉簾裝置只需沿既有軌道移位，工作人員可安排一次短時間的到府服務。如果要移動軌道或改變窗簾長度，工作人員預約施工前必須先安排重測房間。住戶的照片有助於判斷該安排哪一種服務，但不能取代測量。如果請求中提出兩種可能的做法，先判斷哪一種能解決問題，不必一律安排較長的到府服務。
